data.narrative:
Reveal Technology is a Series A defense and security company founded by Garrett Smith that has raised $30M+ to date. Valuation analysis draws from a comparables universe of 10 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage peers—8 private and 2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS)—including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and NODA AI. The peer set spans $125M to $3.0B in valuation.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, anchoring to the $1.0B total raised proxy and applying a typical 2.0x Series A step-up multiplier, implies a $2.0B valuation. Peer-median analysis across the 10-company comparable set yields a $1.0B median valuation, with peer range of $125M–$3.0B. The sample peers shown (Dream Security at $3.0B, Harmattan AI at $1.4B, Code Metal at $1.2B, and Castelion and Defense Unicorns each at $1.0B) are predominantly Series B staged.

Triangulation of these two methods supports a valuation range of $850M–$2.3B, with a median of $1.5B. The $650M spread reflects uncertainty in stage-appropriate risk adjustment and variation in peer company maturity and market positioning. The peer-median method anchors to a lower point estimate, while stage-progression suggests higher upside; resolution depends on revenue trajectory and customer traction relative to the peer cohort.
